<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 10"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Vicious Rend](/Feats.aspx?ID=5432) <actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=535" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 67

**Archetype** [Beastmaster](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=50)

**Prerequisites**
[Beastmaster Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=1900); animal companion with a claw, fist, pincer, or talon unarmed attack

</column>

---

Your companion sinks its claws and rips. Your companions with a qualifying unarmed attack learn the Vicious Rend activity.

 **Vicious Rend** <actions string="Two Actions" /> Make two claw, fist, pincer, or talon Strikes against the same target, applying the multiple attack penalty as normal. If both Strikes hit, the target takes an additional 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). This damage increases to 2d6 if your companion is specialized.
